excerpt: By May 1994 the collaboration had chosen the name BaBar ... the first collision events were collected on 26 May 1999. ... BaBar continued to collect data on or near the Upsilon(4S) meson until 2007 and in 2008 collected large samples ... before PEP-II was shut down.
publisher: CERN Courier (J M Roney and D MacFarlane)
title: BaBar celebrates its 25th anniversary
